items.text: mobile number sahi hai
mera otp kab milega main wait kar raha hu
mobile banking login kar raha hu par otp nahi aa raha
Hyderabad se call kar raha hu mera account block ho gaya
account number 12345678 hai par otp nahi aa pa raha
mera mobile number update karna hai kyunki otp nahi mil raha
kal raat se net banking login nahi ho raha hai
otp toh milta hi nahi baar baar try kar raha hu

items.context: Kya aap apne password ko reset karenge?
items.text: password bar bar galat kaise ho sakta hai main sure hu apne password me

items.context: Kya aapke paas registered mobile number hai?
items.text: mujhe registered mobile number par code bhejo please

items.context: Kya aapke phone me internet connection sahi hai?
items.text: internet achha chal raha hai par login fail ho raha hai

items.context: Kya aap apna address batayenge mujhe?
items.text: address bata du kya jahan se main call kar raha hu
mera OTP nahi aa raha 12 ghante se main wait kar raha hu Bangalore se
Mujhe net banking ka login karna hai par wo OTP nahi bhej raha Mumbai number pe
Main Pune me rehta hu mera account number 987654321 hai aur mujhe OTP nahi aa raha login ke liye

items.context: Kya aap mujhe bata sakte hain ki aapko OTP mil raha hai ya nahi?
items.text: Mujhe OTP nahi aa raha login karne me problem aa rahi hai kya aap meri help karenge main Delhi se bol raha hu

items.context: Kya aapka registered mobile number ab bhi active hai?
items.text: Main Hyderabad ka rehne wala hu mera mobile number update karwana tha kyunki purana number band ho gaya hai OTP nahi aa raha

items.context: Kya aapko apne account number ki jankari confirm karni hai?
items.text: Maine bar baar try kiya Mumbai se OTP ke liye par koi message nahi aaya mera account number 23456789 bhi check kar lijiye

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: login_otp_problem - cannot log in to net or mobile banking or is not receiving the OTP
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
